name: Virtual Pinball Chat
description: Virtual Pinball Chat scores for your tables, with your own username flagged, and the weekly table tagged vp-weekly.
settings.label: Virtual Pinball Chat
settings.usernames.label: Your VPC Usernames
settings.usernames.help: Your Virtual Pinball Chat usernames, separated by commas. Scores by them are flagged in VP Chat and in the scores a theme reads.
settings.check_every.label: Check the Weekly Table
settings.check_every.help: How often this week's table and scores are read. VPinFE reads on a 30 minute tick, so a longer wait skips ticks. Other tables are not affected: their scores are asked for only as you browse to or play them.
settings.keep_scores.label: Keep Table Scores For
settings.keep_scores.help: How long a table's scores are kept before they are asked for again, the next time you browse to it. Forever never expires them: a table is then asked for again only after you play it, or when you use Check Now or Refresh Scores.
